output.brief: Volunteers are leaving because regulars lost their usual weekly shifts, not because the app or the background check is bad in itself. RotaWeave's basic tier has no recurring bookings. Before 1 May, coordinators booked regulars into their slots on their behalf (about 74 a week across Dock Street and Westgate). After the coordinator posts ended, that fell to about 3 a week, and an admin seat sits unused. At Dock Street and Westgate, 129 of 213 April regulars lost their slot at least twice, and 88% of them are now inactive. Only 11% of those who kept their slot are inactive. Millbrook has the app but kept its coordinator, and its numbers are steady. Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but has no app, and its numbers are steady. So the drop needs both changes together. The background check isn't the cause: 121 of the 123 who lapsed had a current check. Commonplate isn't a main cause either: only 2 of the 61 callbacks joined another group. Don't cancel RotaWeave or suspend the check. Assign someone to book regulars into their usual slots before each Thursday release at Dock Street and Westgate, phone lapsed regulars to offer their slots back, and review after 60 days. Plan the Quarry Lane go-live with the same booking arrangement. I'm fairly confident. Don't purge the roster.
